description.value:
The twin to the Youmei, the B-70Z Yan was made on commission for Beijing’s police sniper teams, which is why Kang Tao made sure it can kill damn near anything in one clean headshot. Especially unruly punks like you.

Cost: 4,000eb (Luxury)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Magrail Kit (w/ Headhopper & Headtoll), Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When making an Aimed Shot with this weapon, it deals 1d6 additional damage (6d6) [Headtoll], or 2d6 additional damage (7d6) if firing Improved Smart Ammunition [Headhopper].

Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Magrail Kit (w/ Headhopper & Headtoll), Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
